mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month consecutive rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% signals labor market deterioration, which precedes corporate earnings declines and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing market contraction, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of 60-day horizons.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105.0 combined with unemployment rate above 5.8% signals recessionary supply shock, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0 and UNRATE > 5.8%.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPI inflation exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating price pressures, triggering immediate hawkish policy expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth above 150,000 monthly additions supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer demand (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) combined with rising residential investment (RSAFS) signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand with rising residential investment
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad supply chain disruption, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO and HOUST both decline.
